meaning.en: Of this and that they pleide and gonnen wade / In many an vnkouth, gladde, and depe matere, / As frendes doon whan thei ben mette y-fere [...].
meaning.vi: Của này nọ, họ nài nỉ và gonnen lội / In many an vnkouth, funde, and dep matere, / As frendes doon whan thei ben mette y-fere [...].

meaning.en: 1590, Edmund Spenser, The Faerie Queene, III.1.
meaning.vi: 1590, Edmund Spenser, The Faerie Queene, III.1.
